maintenance_led.reason: Builds and sells new single-family homes to first-time and move-up buyers; revenue comes from new home closings, not repair.

publicly_funded.reason: Homes are bought by private consumers, typically with mortgages, through real estate agents; not government-paid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by building and selling homes in its own communities; only occasional land or builder acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Homebuyers choose among competing builders on price and location; once the home is sold there is no switching cost.
